dwg_modify.offset_tip: Offset the picked lines and arcs by the distance; then click the side on the canvas
dwg_modify.join_tip: Join the picked lines and arcs that touch end to end into one closed polyline
dwg_modify.explode_tip: Split the polylines of the picked lines and arcs into separate lines and arcs
dwg_modify.st.pick_side: Click the side to offset to
dwg_modify.st.only_curves: Only lines and arcs can be offset, joined or exploded: remove texts and fills from the selection
dwg_modify.st.ring_partial: The box covers part of a polyline: pick the whole polyline or only single lines and arcs
dwg_modify.st.dist_bad: Enter a distance greater than zero
dwg_modify.st.on_line: Click beside the picked lines, not on them
dwg_modify.st.arc_small: The distance is larger than the radius of an arc on that side
dwg_modify.st.collapse: A segment would vanish at this distance: enter a smaller one
dwg_modify.st.join_few: Select two or more lines or arcs to join
dwg_modify.st.join_style: Pieces to join must share one layer and one line style
dwg_modify.st.join_circle: A full circle is closed already
dwg_modify.st.join_short: A piece is shorter than the join tolerance: zoom in
dwg_modify.st.join_in_poly: A piece already belongs to a polyline: explode it first
dwg_modify.st.join_branch: Three or more pieces meet at one point
dwg_modify.st.join_split: The selected pieces do not form one chain
dwg_modify.st.join_open: The chain is open, its ends are {gap} apart: only a closed chain becomes one polyline
dwg_modify.st.join_arcs_gap: Two arcs do not meet exactly: connect them with a line first
dwg_modify.st.join_done: Joined into one polyline on layer {layer}: {n}
dwg_modify.st.explode_none: None of the selected lines and arcs belongs to a polyline
dwg_modify.st.explode_circle: A circle has no segments to explode
dwg_modify.st.explode_done: Polylines exploded into lines and arcs: {n}
